why: ¶18 says Silver Blaze has always been a prime favourite with the racing public.
¶18 says Silver Blaze is from the Isonomy stock, his famous ancestor.
¶18 mentions the prizes of the turf, three-to-one betting and enormous sums laid on him.
The story is about a racehorse, so horses as a general topic is plainly present.
The Wessex Cup is named in ¶4 and ¶18 as the race Silver Blaze was favourite for.
¶18 refers to the fall of the flag next Tuesday, which is race day for the Wessex Cup.
